name: CRIT-AID Reliability Audit Software
description: CRIT-AID is an executable empirical reliability audit for AI decision support under distribution shift. It tests the transportability of probability calibration, selection/abstention rules, and conformal uncertainty. Key finding: stable discrimination does not imply stable decision-support reliability.

citation.name: Stable Discrimination Can Hide Reliability Failures in AI Decision Support under Distribution Shift and Changing Target Definitions
